stories.title: EU updates recycled food packaging rules
stories.summary: The European Commission has adopted two regulations to tighten requirements for plastic food-contact materials. The updates expand traceability and compliance documentation for recycled plastics and authorize four new substances for use in food packaging. The changes specifically address oversight of recycling facilities and import controls.

stories.title: UNIST researchers develop PET recycling technology
stories.summary: Researchers at UNIST and POSTECH have developed a method to decompose waste PET bottles using light and heat. The process converts plastic into chemical feedstock in solid and gaseous forms, which the team claims simplifies recovery. Findings were published in the journal Chemical Engineering.

stories.title: Recoup updates design guidance for plastic packaging
stories.summary: Recoup has published its 2026 Recyclability by Design guide to assist companies in optimizing packaging for recycling. The document outlines how material choices, labels and closures impact infrastructure compatibility and helps businesses adapt to the UK-wide extended producer responsibility framework.

stories.title: Amsterdam explores ban on single-use packaging
stories.summary: Amsterdam is researching a potential ban on single-use packaging to curb litter. The municipality commissioned legal platform CircuLaw to assess the feasibility of the move, while studying existing initiatives in Lisbon, Copenhagen and Tübingen to determine how to best manage the city's waste.

stories.title: Suntory prepares for deposit-based recycling
stories.summary: Suntory is focusing on the operational requirements of an upcoming deposit return scheme for single-use drinks containers. Chief executive Elise Seibold stated that the priority is to ensure the system remains simple and convenient, requiring close cooperation between producers, retailers and the government to minimize friction.

The clarification follows questions about whether existing reusable packaging can remain in circulation before new labeling requirements enter into force.

The machine automatically seals cases arriving in random sizes for automated production environments.

stories.summary: Innomation Equipments has launched the VAYU vertical form-fill-seal machine. The company is positioning the platform as a high-performance alternative to both entry-level domestic machinery and premium imported equipment. The development focuses on reducing material wastage and improving machine availability for food manufacturers.

stories.summary: Untha has launched its MR series of single-shaft shredders, including the MR1800C PRO model. stories.summary: The global air cushion packaging market was valued at 4.6 billion dollars in 2025. stories.title: Shrink film demand tracks movement of goods
stories.summary: Shrink film demand is tied to the movement of goods rather than specific industry fortunes. Polyolefin remains the primary material for bundling bottles and pallets. Recycled-content formulations are moving from pilot lines into standard production as e-commerce volumes and tamper-evident packaging requirements reshape the market.

stories.summary: The global high-shrink packaging films market is entering a phase of steady expansion as retailers focus on shelf-ready presentation and tamper evidence. stories.summary: The global cat litter box liner market is a mature, high-frequency replenishment category. stories.summary: The global thermoformed containers market is expected to reach 13.63 billion dollars in 2026, growing to 24.64 billion dollars by 2036. Food packaging accounts for 51 percent of demand, with polystyrene-based containers currently leading the market by material share.

stories.title: EPL targets 35 to 50 million dollars in merger synergies
stories.summary: Mumbai-based tube-packaging company EPL expects its beauty and cosmetics business to remain a key growth driver. Global CEO Hemant Bakshi cited rising consumer demand and premiumization in India as factors creating favorable conditions for the company's packaging business and its merger synergy targets.

stories.title: EPL reports 4 percent profit increase in second quarter
stories.summary: EPL Ltd reported a net profit of 111 crore rupees for the September quarter, up from 106.1 crore rupees a year ago. Revenue rose 30 percent to 1,567.4 crore rupees. Profit growth was impacted by higher depreciation and higher effective tax rates.

stories.title: AltM raises 10.3 million dollars in series A funding
stories.summary: Specialty chemicals startup altM has raised 10.3 million dollars in a series A round led by Rainmatter and Mela Ventures. The company plans to use the capital to scale manufacturing, commercialize bio-based industrial chemicals, and support customer qualification programs.

stories.title: Ester Industries names Nike as anchor customer for recycling plant
stories.summary: Ester Industries plans to produce 45,000 tonnes of recycled PET chips annually through its ELITe chemical-recycling joint venture. Nike is the anchor customer under a multi-year offtake agreement. Commercial operations for the plant are scheduled to begin in the last quarter of 2028.

stories.title: EPL reports 30 percent revenue growth for second quarter
stories.summary: EPL Limited reported revenue of 15,674 million rupees for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027, a 30 percent increase year-over-year. The company attributed the performance to resilient business models and customer partnerships, despite ongoing global market volatility and geopolitical disruptions.

stories.title: Ringmetall acquires Rapak to expand in North America
stories.summary: Germany-based Ringmetall SE has acquired Rapak LLC from TriMas Corporation. The deal adds manufacturing facilities in Illinois and Indiana to the company's operations. The acquisition makes Ringmetall the fourth-largest bag-in-box manufacturer worldwide, according to the company.

stories.title: Quick-commerce startup Blitz raises 28.7 crore rupees
stories.summary: Fulfilment startup Blitz has raised 28.7 crore rupees in a pre-series B funding round led by IvyCap Ventures. The company issued shares at 13,118 rupees each to strengthen operations and expand its fulfilment network. The transaction values the business at approximately 150 crore rupees.

stories.title: Aruwa Capital invests in Polysmart Packaging
stories.summary: Lagos-based Aruwa Capital Management has invested in Nigerian plastic recycling firm Polysmart Packaging. The investment, made through Aruwa Capital Fund II, is intended to support the company's growth strategy and expand its operational capacity for sustainable packaging solutions across West Africa.

stories.title: Mold-Tek Packaging reports 35.5 percent profit growth
stories.summary: Mold-Tek Packaging posted a net profit of 21.06 crore rupees for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027, a 35.5 percent increase over the previous year. Revenue from operations reached 274.22 crore rupees, marking a 30.1 percent rise.
